objective: Make every ExplorerResult that leaves packages/explorer use standard UCI for castling (e1g1, e1c1, e8g8, e8c8), whether it came from a fresh Lichess response or from the SQLite cache (entries written before this fix may carry Lichess's king-takes-rook spelling e1h1/e1a1/e8h8/e8a8). Non-castling moves, including other king moves from e1/e8, must pass through unchanged.
contract:
Current code at base 02395bb:

packages/explorer/src/schema.ts parseExplorerResponse(raw) maps each Lichess move as { uci: m.uci, san: m.san, games: white+draws+black, white, draws, black, averageRating } and sorts by games desc. cachedResultSchema validates our own ExplorerResult shape on cache read.

packages/explorer/src/cache.ts createSqliteExplorerCache(path, ttlMs).get(key, nowMs) parses the row body with cachedResultSchema and returns parsed.data; set() stores { moves, totalGames, opening } and never stores results with 'unavailable'.

packages/explorer/src/types.ts:
  export interface ExplorerMove { uci: string; san: string; games: number; white: number; draws: number; black: number; averageRating: number; }
  export interface ExplorerResult { moves: ExplorerMove[]; totalGames: number; opening: { eco: string; name: string } | null; unavailable?: OutOfBookReason; }

Rule (from issue #17): rewrite uci only when san is O-O or O-O-O (optionally followed by + or #) AND uci is the king-to-own-rook form: e1h1->e1g1, e1a1->e1c1, e8h8->e8g8, e8a8->e8c8. If uci is already standard, leave it. A move like Kf1 (e1f1) or a king capture that is not castling stays untouched. Apply on parse AND on cache read (either normalize in get(), or route both through one exported-internally helper; do not bump the cache key, existing rows must still be served).

Lichess spelling is not confirmed offline: the recorded fixture test/fixtures/london-after-bf4.json and spike 002 contain no castling move, and no LICHESS_TOKEN is available to agents. Add a new fixture (e.g. test/fixtures/castling-synthetic.json) shaped exactly like london-after-bf4.json, clearly named/commented as synthetic (hand-written, not recorded), containing O-O with e8h8 (and one with already-standard e8g8 to prove idempotence). Position suggestion: after 1.d4 Nf6 2.Bf4 g6 3.e3 Bg7 4.Nf3 d6 5.Be2, Black to move, where O-O is a popular book move. The live confirmation is the user's job via pnpm demo:bot; note that in contract_gaps, don't attempt network calls.
